champs.name: amount
champs.help: Annual amount of the module. Split by the contract cadence when billed.

champs.name: end_year
champs.help: Last year the module is billed. Leave empty to bill until the contract end year.

champs.name: product_id
champs.help: Article used on the order / invoice line for this module. If empty, the module's default article is used, otherwise the contract product.

champs.name: start_year
champs.help: First year the module is billed (e.g. 2027).

champs.name: cancel_old_lines_invoiced
champs.help: Adds a note on the unbilled yearly lines of the old contract to signal the carry-over to the new one.

champs.name: generate_lines
champs.field_description: Generate the New Contract Yearly Lines

champs.name: syntec_rate
champs.help: Percentage of revaluation applied to the maintenance amount.

champs.name: billing_frequency_ids
champs.help: A single contract may combine several frequencies (e.g. Annual + Overdue).

champs.name: contract_module_line_ids
champs.help: Assistance modules billed on top of the maintenance, each with its own annual amount and a start year. They generate their own order / invoice lines for the years within their window.

champs.name: duration
champs.help: Duration the contract was ordered for. Informational: the billing periods are derived from the start and end dates, not from this field.

champs.name: gen_id
champs.help: Drugcam generation covered by the contract. Editable list: add a generation from Maintenance > Configuration > Generations, no code change needed.

champs.name: maintenance_amount
champs.help:
Reference amount per year, used to pre-fill the yearly lines on the first 'Generate Yearly Lines'.
It is NOT what gets billed: the contract value and the invoices are built from the 'Yearly Amounts' tab, which is where an amount that changes from year to year must be entered.

champs.name: market_type_ids
champs.help: Market / public tender. Editable list, several values allowed.

champs.name: partner_id
champs.help: Any client company can be selected. It is automatically flagged as a Maintenance Establishment when the contract is created.

champs.name: product_name
champs.help:
Wording used on the customer order and invoice lines, before the number of workstations and the billed period.
Pre-filled from the product's sales description ('Sales' tab, 'Sales Description'); can be overridden manually.

champs.name: renewed_from_id
champs.help: Set automatically by the renewal wizard.

champs.name: total_contract_value
champs.help: Sum of the yearly amounts of all contract lines.

champs.name: is_invoiced
champs.help: Checked as soon as at least one invoice covers the line.

champs.name: partner_id
champs.help: Any client company can be selected. It is automatically flagged as a Maintenance Establishment when the contract is created.

champs.name: apply_syntec
champs.help:
Revalues the covered year before creating the order. The revised amount is written back onto the contract's yearly line, so the contract, the order and the invoices stay consistent.
Only available on the 'Year' scope: revaluing the whole contract in one go is done through the renewal wizard.

champs.name: customer_po_reference
champs.help: Purchase order number sent by the customer. Leave empty at the quotation stage and fill it in on the order once received.

champs.name: revised_amount
champs.help: Amount actually ordered and written back onto the contract. Suggested from the rate, but freely editable (e.g. to match the exact figure of the customer purchase order).

champs.name: year
champs.help: Contract year covered by the order. Ignored if scope = Whole contract.

champs.name: product_id
champs.help: Catalogue article used by default on the order / invoice lines when this module is billed on a contract.

res_partner.name: activity_exception_decoration
res_partner.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

res_partner.name: activity_exception_icon
res_partner.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

res_partner.name: activity_state
res_partner.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

res_partner.name: activity_type_icon
res_partner.help: Font awesome icon e.g. fa-tasks

res_partner.name: autopost_bills
res_partner.help: Automatically post bills for this trusted partner

res_partner.name: barcode
res_partner.help: Use a barcode to identify this contact.

res_partner.name: calendar_last_notif_ack
res_partner.field_description: Last notification marked as read from base Calendar

res_partner.name: central_purchasing_id
res_partner.help: Central purchasing body / buying group (editable list).

res_partner.name: company_registry
res_partner.help: The registry number of the company. Use it if it is different from the Tax ID. It must be unique across all partners of a same country

res_partner.name: country_code
res_partner.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

res_partner.name: credit
res_partner.help: Total amount this customer owes you.

res_partner.name: credit_limit
res_partner.help: Credit limit specific to this partner.

res_partner.name: d2p_life
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for incoming invoices.

res_partner.name: d2p_ly
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for incoming invoices last year.

res_partner.name: d2p_ytd
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for incoming invoices this year.

res_partner.name: d2r_life
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for outgoing invoices.

res_partner.name: d2r_ly
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for outgoing invoices last year.

res_partner.name: d2r_ytd
res_partner.help: Average days of payment for outgoing invoices this year.

res_partner.name: days_sales_outstanding
res_partner.help: [(Total Receivable/Total Revenue) * number of days since the first invoice] for this customer

res_partner.name: debit
res_partner.help: Total amount you have to pay to this vendor.

res_partner.name: department_number
res_partner.help: French department number (01, 02, ..., 95, 2A, 2B, 971, ...).

res_partner.name: email_formatted
res_partner.help: Format email address "Name <email@domain>"

res_partner.name: email_normalized
res_partner.help: This field is used to search on email address as the primary email field can contain more than strictly an email address.

res_partner.name: employee
res_partner.help: Check this box if this contact is an Employee.

res_partner.name: employee_ids
res_partner.help: Related employees based on their private address

res_partner.name: followup_next_action_date
res_partner.help:
No follow-up action will be taken before this date.
                Sending a reminder will set this date depending on the levels configuration, and you can change it manually.

res_partner.name: followup_responsible_id
res_partner.help: The responsible assigned to manual followup activities, if defined in the level.

res_partner.name: helpdesk_warn
res_partner.help: Selecting the "Warning" option will notify user with the message, Selecting "Blocking Message" will throw an exception with the message and block the flow. The Message has to be written in the next field.

res_partner.name: invoice_warn
res_partner.help: Selecting the "Warning" option will notify user with the message, Selecting "Blocking Message" will throw an exception with the message and block the flow. The Message has to be written in the next field.

res_partner.name: is_blacklisted
res_partner.help: If the email address is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing anymore, from any list

res_partner.name: is_company
res_partner.help: Check if the contact is a company, otherwise it is a person

res_partner.name: is_maintenance_establishment
res_partner.help: Tick if this contact is a client establishment tracked for the Eurekam maintenance contracts. Only ticked contacts appear in the selection list when creating a contract.

res_partner.name: iso20022_lei
res_partner.help: Legal Entity Identifier

res_partner.name: lang
res_partner.help: All the emails and documents sent to this contact will be translated in this language.

res_partner.name: maintenance_status
res_partner.help:
Synthetic indicator visible to the whole team (notably support) summarizing the maintenance contract state and the commercial relationship of the establishment. Computed in real time.
- ACTIVE: at least 1 active contract
- EXPIRING SOON: no active one but at least 1 expiring within 90 days
- EXPIRED: all contracts are expired
- Customer WITHOUT contract: no contract but at least 1 customer order (potential to convert)
- No commercial relationship: neither contract nor order in Odoo

res_partner.name: message_bounce
res_partner.help: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact

res_partner.name: message_has_error
res_partner.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

res_partner.name: message_has_error_counter
res_partner.help: Number of messages with delivery error

res_partner.name: message_has_sms_error
res_partner.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

res_partner.name: message_needaction
res_partner.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

res_partner.name: message_needaction_counter
res_partner.help: Number of messages requiring action

res_partner.name: mobile_blacklisted
res_partner.help: Indicates if a blacklisted sanitized phone number is a mobile number. Helps distinguish which number is blacklisted             when there is both a mobile and phone field in a model.

res_partner.name: nb_workstations
res_partner.help: Number of Drugcam workstations installed on site.

res_partner.name: ocn_token
res_partner.help: Used for sending notification to registered devices

res_partner.name: on_time_rate
res_partner.help: Over the past x days; the number of products received on time divided by the number of ordered products.x is either the System Parameter purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days or the default 365

res_partner.name: partner_share
res_partner.help: Either customer (not a user), either shared user. Indicated the current partner is a customer without access or with a limited access created for sharing data.

res_partner.name: peppol_eas
res_partner.help:
Code used to identify the Endpoint for BIS Billing 3.0 and its derivatives.
             List available at https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/codelist/eas/

res_partner.name: peppol_endpoint
res_partner.help: Unique identifier used by the BIS Billing 3.0 and its derivatives, also known as 'Endpoint ID'.

res_partner.name: phone_blacklisted
res_partner.help: Indicates if a blacklisted sanitized phone number is a phone number. Helps distinguish which number is blacklisted             when there is both a mobile and phone field in a model.

res_partner.name: phone_sanitized
res_partner.help: Field used to store sanitized phone number. Helps speeding up searches and comparisons.

res_partner.name: phone_sanitized_blacklisted
res_partner.help: If the sanitized phone number is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing sms anymore, from any list

res_partner.name: picking_warn
res_partner.help: Selecting the "Warning" option will notify user with the message, Selecting "Blocking Message" will throw an exception with the message and block the flow. The Message has to be written in the next field.

res_partner.name: property_account_payable_id
res_partner.help: This account will be used instead of the default one as the payable account for the current partner

res_partner.name: property_account_position_id
res_partner.help: The fiscal position determines the taxes/accounts used for this contact.

res_partner.name: property_account_receivable_id
res_partner.help: This account will be used instead of the default one as the receivable account for the current partner

res_partner.name: property_inbound_payment_method_line_id
res_partner.help: Preferred payment method when selling to this customer. This will be set by default on all incoming payments created for this customer

res_partner.name: property_outbound_payment_method_line_id
res_partner.help: Preferred payment method when buying from this vendor. This will be set by default on all outgoing payments created for this vendor

res_partner.name: property_payment_term_id
res_partner.help: This payment term will be used instead of the default one for sales orders and customer invoices

res_partner.name: property_product_pricelist
res_partner.help: This pricelist will be used, instead of the default one, for sales to the current partner

res_partner.name: property_purchase_currency_id
res_partner.help: This currency will be used, instead of the default one, for purchases from the current partner

res_partner.name: property_stock_customer
res_partner.help: The stock location used as destination when sending goods to this contact.

res_partner.name: property_stock_supplier
res_partner.help: The stock location used as source when receiving goods from this contact.

res_partner.name: property_supplier_payment_term_id
res_partner.help: This payment term will be used instead of the default one for purchase orders and vendor bills

res_partner.name: purchase_warn
res_partner.help: Selecting the "Warning" option will notify user with the message, Selecting "Blocking Message" will throw an exception with the message and block the flow. The Message has to be written in the next field.

res_partner.name: receipt_reminder_email
res_partner.help: Automatically send a confirmation email to the vendor X days before the expected receipt date, asking him to confirm the exact date.

res_partner.name: reminder_date_before_receipt
res_partner.help: Number of days to send reminder email before the promised receipt date

res_partner.name: sale_warn
res_partner.help: Selecting the "Warning" option will notify user with the message, Selecting "Blocking Message" will throw an exception with the message and block the flow. The Message has to be written in the next field.

res_partner.name: sla_ids
res_partner.help: SLA Policies that will automatically apply to the tickets submitted by this customer.

res_partner.name: trust
res_partner.field_description: Degree of trust you have in this debtor

res_partner.name: tz
res_partner.help:
When printing documents and exporting/importing data, time values are computed according to this timezone.
If the timezone is not set, UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) is used.
Anywhere else, time values are computed according to the time offset of your web client.

res_partner.name: use_partner_credit_limit
res_partner.help: Set a value greater than 0.0 to activate a credit limit check

res_partner.name: user_id
res_partner.help: The internal user in charge of this contact.

res_partner.name: vat
res_partner.help: The Tax Identification Number. Values here will be validated based on the country format. You can use '/' to indicate that the partner is not subject to tax.

res_partner.name: vies_valid
res_partner.help: European VAT numbers are automatically checked on the VIES database.

res_partner.name: website_id
res_partner.help: Restrict to a specific website.

res_partner.name: website_message_ids
res_partner.help: Website communication history

res_partner.name: website_url
res_partner.help: The full URL to access the document through the website.
